description: This PHP source file defines the JobTitle class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable, providing functionality related to filtering by job titles in HR reports. It includes methods for augmenting query builders with job title constraints, retrieving entity aliases, and converting job title entity data into array form for further processing.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: Represents a filter field for job titles in HR reports, allowing to add filtering conditions to query builders and converting job title entities into array format for display or processing.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a filter condition to the query builder for matching a specific job title if the operator is EQUAL and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query, here it is ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Retrieves the job title entity by ID and returns its id and label as an array; returns null if no valid job title is found.
